how: Captured native hook stdin as the dedicated test OS user in a temporary HOME and CODEX_HOME (Asia/Singapore). Trusted the capture hooks through the Codex app server and ran one real print-mode turn with the official Responses API over HTTP, prompting gpt-5.4-mini to execute printf fixture-codex. The CLI reported the native hook tool name Bash.

files.session-start-startup.json: Native SessionStart from the captured turn.
files.user-prompt-submit.json: Synthetic user prompt requesting a single shell command.
files.pre-tool-use.json: Native PreToolUse for the shell command, emitted as Bash.
files.post-tool-use.json: Matching native PostToolUse for the shell command.
files.stop.json: Native Stop after the shell turn.
